description:
Split from op-9c2e (GitHub issue #30 body, point 1: 'no file picker, i want to be able to pick files off'). kovan-gui / kovan_literature::digitiser::gui::run currently only loads an image via a CLI arg at launch -- no in-app picker.

SCOPE: add a native file-open dialog to the digitiser GUI, so a user can pick a plot image (and, once op-6ez3/op-9c2e.4 land, a PDF) without relaunching the binary with a path argument.

REUSE FIRST (workspace CLAUDE.md hard rule): crates/tampines-steam-tables/examples/tampines-steam-tables-gui already solved exactly this with egui-file-dialog 0.13.0, pinned specifically to match this workspace's egui/eframe 0.34.3 (see that crate's Cargo.toml comment). kovan's digitiser GUI is on the same egui/eframe versions (workspace deps) -- reuse the same crate and the same pattern (open dialog -> pending-pick state carried across frames -> resolve on the frame the pick lands) rather than re-deriving it.

Does not depend on op-6ez3 (PDF rendering) -- the image-file picker is useful and shippable against the current PNG/JPEG-only digitiser on its own; a PDF entry becomes pickable once op-9c2e.4 lands.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content: Implemented: reused egui-file-dialog (already a workspace dependency via tampines-steam-tables-gui) rather than hand-rolling a picker. One FileDialog instance shared by the digitiser's 'Browse...' button and the new PDF reader's 'Open PDF...' button, routed via a FileDialogTarget{Image,Pdf} enum. Two named extension filters registered (Images: png/jpg/jpeg, PDF: pdf). Added as a new target-gated (non-Android) optional dep under the gui feature. Verified: cargo tree confirms zero egui-file-dialog on the android target; cargo check clean both targets.

title: kovan-gui: file picker for the digitiser (and PDF reader once it exists)

description: Add Taubin's two-pass lambda|mu smoothing on top of the discrete Laplacian: alternating positive (lambda) and negative (mu) explicit Laplacian passes to denoise without the volume shrinkage of plain Laplacian smoothing. Reuses laplacian edge weights.
title: outram-blender: Taubin (lambda|mu) shrinkage-free smoothing

description: GitHub issue #30 comment 5384356411: replace the separate Highlight/Note/CropForDigitise/CropForTableDigitise toolbar tools with one 'draw a box' gesture. Right-clicking a freshly-drawn box should offer a menu: 1. Annotate (raw text input) 2. Digitise graph (crop into the plot digitiser, CSV auto-saves into markdown but retains export) 3. Read table (OCR first pass, human review/edit, save into CSV). Right-clicking an EXISTING box should offer edit/add/clear/delete instead. Depends on op-7amv's markdown-persistence child for the 'auto-saves into markdown' half.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content:
Implemented. crates/kovan/src/digitiser/gui/desktop/pdf_reader.rs was substantially rewritten:
- AnnotationTool shrunk to None (pan/zoom + right-click existing) | DrawBox (drag to propose a new box) -- the separate Highlight/Note/CropForDigitise/CropForTableDigitise toolbar tools are gone; every new box goes through the same gesture.
- Right-click inside the just-drawn (pending, unconfirmed) box opens a floating context menu (egui::Area, positioned at the click) offering Annotate / Digitise graph / Read table, matching the issue comment's numbered list exactly.
- Right-click inside an already-saved annotation box opens a different menu: Edit / Delete.
- "Annotate" opens a text-editor panel under the toolbar (not a canvas-anchored popup -- simpler and immune to scroll-coordinate edge cases); Save records the note with page/pixel-bbox/timestamp/author (op-96am's provenance shape). "Digitise graph"/"Read table" reuse the existing crop_current_page path unchanged, now carrying a CropProvenance (page index, pixel bbox, timestamp, author) through CropResult so the receiving digitiser tab can save its CSV back into the project (op-96am, see that bead's comment).
- Existing annotation boxes are hover-highlighted (brighter fill/stroke while the pointer is over them) -- the PDF-reader-side half of op-4x5s; the right-panel-linking half still needs op-0y4k's layout first.

Known, deliberate scope cut: an already-confirmed Digitise-graph/Read-table crop is NOT tracked as a re-editable box in the reader (matches the pre-existing behavior -- the crop is consumed immediately on confirm) -- only Annotate-type boxes get Edit/Delete. Revisit if that turns out to matter in practice.

cargo check --all-targets clean (native + aarch64-linux-android), cargo test --release: 183 kovan lib tests passing (no test regressions; this module has no unit tests of its own -- it's GUI-only, consistent with how the rest of desktop/ is tested, i.e. not at all beyond compile + the shared xvfb smoke test). Not committed yet.

title: kovan-gui: unified box interaction model -- draw box, right-click offers Annotate/Digitise graph/Read table; edit/add/clear/delete on existing box

description:
math::parallel::gpu::quadratic_roots_batch is documented as max rel 2.85e-7 / RMS 5.70e-8 over 262144 equations — but that measurement used WELL-SEPARATED roots only, and the docs say so explicitly rather than implying a general bound.

The gap matters: QuadraticEqn::roots on the CPU uses an FMA-compensated discriminant precisely for the case where b^2/4 and a*c nearly cancel. WGSL's fma is not guaranteed to be a fused single-rounding operation, so the GPU kernel drops that compensation. The near-degenerate range is therefore exactly where the two paths should diverge most, and it is currently unmeasured. The parity gate is set at 1e-4 rather than at the measured value to leave room for it.

Do: sweep discriminant magnitude from well-separated down to ~0 (e.g. roots separated by 1e-1 down to 1e-7), measure max/RMS relative deviation per band, and either tighten the gate with confidence or document a range where the GPU kernel should not be used.
title: outram-foam-basic-lib: characterise the quadratic root GPU kernel near a double root
